How to use the Technology Radar

Introduction

Edit this file to your needs to provide an introduction to the technology radar. Explain the purpose of the radar and how it is created. This is a good place to explain the quadrants and rings, too.

Contributing to the AOE Technology Radar

Contributions and source code of the AOE Tech Radar are on GitHub: AOE Tech Radar on GitHub
